17:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: PTI 25th Anniversary Special
Celebrating the silver anniversary of Pardon the Interruption with a special double-episode event, marking a quarter-century of one of sports television's most enduring programs.

17:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Pardon the Interruption
The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day.
